\paragraph{Faster rows.}
Pre-repair run 21070 bucketed rows faster than monolithic: 21/735. These rows are negative diagnostic evidence from the pre-repair executor, not paper-scale speedup evidence.
Repaired local non-analysis bucketed rows faster than monolithic: 0/11.

\paragraph{Mechanism versus scheduler.}
Executed lane-steps are hardware independent and separate the executor from the scheduler. The deployed scheduler reached an executed-work ratio of 0.688, while oracle plans on the same realized depths reach 0.172 through the same executor.
Planning accounted for 11.1\% of warm time.
The oracle\_current wall speedup of 1.324x is an analysis-only upper bound and cannot satisfy the wall-clock gate.

\paragraph{Decision.}
The gate failed; broad sweeps remain blocked and T38 is not promoted.

Next task guidance: Do not promote T38. Mechanism present, wall-clock gate not met: the executor reclaims work but the deployed predictor does not find it. The next task should repair predictor quality and planner cost, not run HPC validation.
